profile.summary:
Software Engineer, project lead, software development, tuning,sun certified web component, sun certified business component, sun certified programmer.

Specialty: J2EE,Java EE 6 and 7, Spring, Scala, Play Framework. Software Design Patterns.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego y alrededores, Estados Unidos
positions.description:
Software development, design, architecture, testing.

Develop Web service application for new XLDP (Pricing model Module) modules that significantly increased premium profit margins on issued policies while reducing the costs of preparing complex pricing models by underwriter staff.
+ Improved the scalability of application by more than 100% when application is loading claims/policies by fixing memory leaks problems and applying design patterns and best practices in the application integration module that load information into SAP in order to avoid server restart.

positions.title: Software Engineer /Project Lead/Java Architect
positions.description:
Software development, design, architecture, testing.

Production support for internal customers fixing blocker, showstopper issues for insurance company OneBeacon and Insurance Company of the West.
+ Application development for Insurance company of the west during SAP modules, XLDP modules for states CA, TX, IL
+ Develop Web service applications for XLDP

positions.title: TECHNICAL LEADER, SOFTWARE ARCHITECT, PROJECT LEADER, J2EE ARCHITECT
positions.description: Improved time to deliver an insurance product created by an actuary by 600 % reducing time to market the product by months by Leading, designing, coordinating and developing kernel modules of ICE application implemented on J2EE, .NET and ColdFusion platforms. This kernel allowed the company to create insurance business rules dynamically per Insurance specialists.

positions.title: BUSINESS ANALYST/SYSTEM ANALYST / J2EE SENIOR DEVELOPER
positions.description:
Systems analysis, application development for mobile or cell phones with Java, JSP and WML. (WAP)

I helped to develop a WAP-based Chat application on the Wap site mipunto.com and enable company to increase revenues given an universe of 5 millions of possible customers by using J2EE and WML and develop unit tests as well as quality improvement strategies to improve the quality of deliverable

positions.title: J2EE/VB/ASP DEVELOPER
positions.description: As a developer I helped building online voting system that Improved the participation in elections by more than 100% by using web technologies J2EE, postgreSql, C,C++, linux. This system was the first online election in history of Simon Bolivar University.
